subject: general
question: Simplify the expression (sqrt{81} + sqrt{0.81} + sqrt{0.0081})sqrt{10000}.
solution:
**Concept used:**

BODMAS

B- Bracket

O- Of

D- Division

M- Multiplication

A- Addition

S- Substraction

Hence, priority of operation will be on the basis of the letter coming first in the word BODMAS.

**Calculations:**

 (sqrt{81} + sqrt{0.81} + sqrt{0.0081})sqrt{10000}

= (9 + 0.9 + 0.09)√10000

= (9.99)100

= 999

**Hence, The Required simplified value is 999.**
